code_path: build_surface_region_semantic_cache.py passed field.radio_features directly to SurfaceRegionSummaryReadoutV2 without enforcing the declared l2_direction contract
impact: Feature encoders begin with LayerNorm, but the readout base contains an unnormalized raw weighted mean and the frozen official summary head is nonlinear; therefore the mismatch changes both gauge and text-response geometry.
fix_policy: Expose both gauges explicitly and bind the selected mode into resume/output metadata. Keep legacy_raw for the accepted old checkpoint; use l2_direction only with a jointly trained compatible readout. Evaluate either mode without changing field, thresholds, scales, or queries.
